features.name: Automatic page discovery
features.requirement: Discover visible headings, landmarks, forms, inputs, choices, buttons, links, menus, searches, tables, documents and job cards from semantic HTML. Exclude Roha UI.
features.acceptance: A new labelled fixture is understood without a supplied site schema.

features.name: Accessible names and ambiguity
features.requirement: Resolve labels, aria-labelledby, aria-label and semantic text. Use surrounding section/form context to distinguish repeated names.
features.acceptance: Two Apply buttons in different job cards are identified by job context; an ambiguous request asks which one.

features.name: Generated JSON map and live registry
features.requirement: Generate versioned public page metadata with session IDs. Keep actual DOM handles in a separate local registry; exclude raw HTML, selectors and entered field values from the map.
features.acceptance: Schema-valid map references current targets; stale or invented target IDs cannot execute.

features.name: Dynamic pages and navigation
features.requirement: Observe relevant DOM/route/menu changes with debouncing, scoped rescans and cancellation. Do not steal focus.
features.acceptance: A dynamically added labelled field appears once; removed fields cannot receive later proposals.

features.name: Optional host overrides
features.requirement: Expose trusted metadata/handler overrides for difficult controls, privacy classification, page caching and authorised submission. Basic discovery remains automatic.
features.acceptance: One script works on two ordinary hosts; an override improves a custom control without changing the core.

features.name: Honest unsupported-control handling
features.requirement: Identify unlabelled or unsupported controls, closed shadow roots, inaccessible documents, cross-origin frames and canvas boundaries.
features.acceptance: Roha gives a plain fallback or asks the host for support; it never invents a successful interaction.

features.name: Website compatibility report
features.requirement: Provide a developer-only report of discovered tasks, ambiguous/unlabelled controls and missing adapters. Do not expose private field values or present it as a WCAG certification.
features.acceptance: A host engineer can see actionable integration gaps without learner data.

features.name: Enable voice and visible permission state
features.requirement: Use an accessible user-initiated microphone permission flow, processing notice, listening/speaking states and a persistent Stop control.
features.acceptance: Denied permission leaves a usable keyboard/text flow with no answer loss.

features.name: Natural turn-taking
features.requirement: After permission, alternate listening and speaking without a click per question. Prevent echo/self-transcription. Keep a transcript and text controls.
features.acceptance: One real recorded conversation fills several answers without microphone clicks between fields.

features.name: Foreground name activation
features.requirement: Use the proposed phrase Hey Roha only after explicit enablement and actual testing. Always provide tap/keyboard activation.
features.acceptance: Activation works in the documented foreground/device profile; unavailable wake support is labelled.

features.name: Conversation state and answer correction
features.requirement: Track current task/question, proposed value, accepted value and navigation state. Allow change, cancel, back and final review.
features.acceptance: A deliberately misheard answer is corrected and the right value remains after back/next navigation.

features.name: Voice navigation and recovery
features.requirement: Support read, repeat, slower, stop speaking, pause, continue, back, next, explain, review and correction.
features.acceptance: Core intents work through a local command router even when the LLM is disabled; text alternatives work.

features.name: No invented user information
features.requirement: Learn the preferred name from the learner or permitted profile context; use only relevant session information.
features.acceptance: Roha asks an unknown name and never fabricates contact, identity, qualification or eligibility details.

features.name: Spelling and number verification
features.requirement: Offer optional spell-it mode for names/email and digit-by-digit phone review. Distinguish spoken words from navigation commands in dictation.
features.acceptance: A mixed spelling/number example can be corrected without unintended Next or Submit actions.

features.name: Interruption and resume recap
features.requirement: Pause safely; let the learner stop speech immediately and request a short recap on resume. Full-duplex voice interruption is optional and must be tested.
features.acceptance: Stopping does not discard accepted answers; resume states the current task without exposing private details aloud.

features.name: Real text scaling and reset
features.requirement: Apply reversible text/control scaling to supported host content; respect existing zoom and prevent clipped actions.
features.acceptance: Voice or text enlarges actual host content, reset works, and 200% zoom remains usable.

features.name: Simple explanation with original available
features.requirement: Use reviewed short explanations first; an optional local LLM can explain selected content without changing original wording or meaning.
features.acceptance: The simpler question preserves consent/eligibility choices and the original remains available.

features.name: Read-aloud and page navigation
features.requirement: Read selected content, question, choices and headings; move to named sections/links using the live registry.
features.acceptance: The correct content is read or focused, and Stop always works.

features.name: Contrast, motion and calm view
features.requirement: Offer high contrast, reduced motion and a reversible calmer presentation that preserves content and native semantics.
features.acceptance: Settings do not remove instructions, status meaning or controls; reset restores the host view.

features.name: Keyboard, screen reader and sound-off parity
features.requirement: Use clear labels, logical focus, visible focus, useful status announcements, no traps, non-obscuring controls and text equivalents.
features.acceptance: The complete primary task is testable with keyboard, NVDA, TalkBack, sound off and 200% zoom.

features.name: Orientation: where am I?
features.requirement: Give a short page overview, current section and available tasks using discovered content.
features.acceptance: Roha explains the actual page and offers only actions currently present.

features.name: Preview and undo local changes
features.requirement: Show/read what Roha proposes; undo reversible preferences and unsubmitted field edits. Never imply an external submission was undone.
features.acceptance: An accidental local change is reverted; completed external writes are clearly distinguished.

features.name: Optional reading focus and spacing
features.requirement: Add an opt-in reading ruler or spacing preference only if it does not interfere with selection, screen readers or reflow.
features.acceptance: The enhancement is reversible and passes the same keyboard/zoom checks as the default view.

features.name: Sign-up and profile engine
features.requirement: Guide one question per screen with clear labels, native inputs, plain validation and profile editing. Synchronise approved values with the original form.
features.acceptance: The learner completes and edits a profile without duplicate IDs or conflicting controls.

features.name: Voice answers, review and edit
features.requirement: Support appropriate text/choice fields by voice and provide correction and final review. Respect host constraints and server validation.
features.acceptance: A learner can reject or edit any recognised answer before sharing.

features.name: No form inactivity timer
features.requirement: Do not expire active questions or clear drafts because of silence. Explain a host session expiry and preserve permitted progress.
features.acceptance: After an idle period, the task remains recoverable; Roha does not claim it can extend host authentication.

features.name: Low-literacy route
features.requirement: Use short words, text-labelled icons, numbered choices, read-aloud questions and visible progress without inventing a total step count.
features.acceptance: The low-literacy route reaches review with text/sound-off alternatives.

features.name: Alternative ID routes
features.requirement: Allow refugee ID, other documents or partner referral where the host permits them. Explain each route plainly.
features.acceptance: A learner without national/kebele ID or passport reaches review without a forced national-ID upload.

features.name: Private support without medical proof
features.requirement: Keep support requests separate from the public application and require no diagnosis, medical proof or disability label.
features.acceptance: Support content is absent from employer/public exports, generic completion events and telemetry.

features.name: Learner-controlled attachments
features.requirement: Explain file type/size, focus the native picker, announce selected filenames and handle cancellation/error. Recheck uploads server-side.
features.acceptance: The learner chooses a document; Roha neither scans folders nor pretends voice bypasses browser/OS permission.

features.name: Consent, review and truthful submission
features.requirement: Summarise public answers separately from private support; obtain explicit final approval; distinguish prepared, pending, received and failed.
features.acceptance: No submission occurs before approval; success requires a real host receipt.

features.name: Minimal save/resume and deletion
features.requirement: Use explicit trusted-device consent for permitted draft fields, portable export and deletion. Exclude private support, document bytes and identity details by default.
features.acceptance: A recovered draft explains omitted fields and does not include sensitive/private data.

features.name: Conversational job application
features.requirement: Reuse the same guided engine for job answers, optional CV selection, correction and final review.
features.acceptance: A sample job application reaches review through the same reusable SDK.

features.name: Private support-needs job filter
features.requirement: Filter using explicitly selected needs and employer-declared accommodations. Keep preferences out of application payloads and request logs by default.
features.acceptance: A supported filter changes matching examples locally without disability inference or disclosure.

features.name: Employer accommodations form
features.requirement: Collect what support the employer offers and a private way to request it; do not require candidates to disclose a diagnosis.
features.acceptance: An employer listing supplies meaningful declared accommodations for filtering.

features.name: Job context and application checklist
features.requirement: Read/explain the selected job and show missing application items based on its declared requirements.
features.acceptance: Roha does not invent a live vacancy, requirement, employer promise or completed application.

features.name: Host-origin offline cache
features.requirement: Cache the core, approved public host routes/content and selected packs with versioned service-worker rules. Never cache private API responses by default.
features.acceptance: After installation, the declared offline journey survives an internet-disconnected reload.

features.name: Explicit runtime profiles
features.requirement: Separate device-local, local-network hub and optional remote operation. Use appropriate trusted transport and per-profile capability checks.
features.acceptance: The UI honestly states whether internet, LAN or installed local services are required.

features.name: Pack installation and readiness
features.requirement: Offer size/progress/cancel/checksum/version controls for selected packs. Use an Offline ready check that tests actual availability.
features.acceptance: The readiness screen identifies missing packs or providers rather than showing a false ready badge.

features.name: Loss recovery without duplicate sends
features.requirement: Preserve permitted progress during network failure; reconnection does not auto-submit. Refresh session/data and use idempotency for approved submission.
features.acceptance: A lost response/retry does not create duplicate applications or discard the draft.

features.name: Small, measured core
features.requirement: Keep model/audio/font payloads optional, avoid continuous uploads and remote assets, and target 150 KB compressed core JS/CSS. Measure actual size and inference impact.
features.acceptance: The report lists measured bundle bytes and any unmet performance target instead of an unsupported claim.

features.name: Language-pack architecture
features.requirement: Support en, am, ti and om configuration with separate UI, command, transcription, dynamic TTS and wake capabilities.
features.acceptance: Each language/capability is independently marked verified, partial, unavailable or not tested.

features.name: Reviewed translations and prompt audio
features.requirement: Obtain native-speaker review of question text and simpler explanations; use licensed recordings where useful. Recordings do not imply arbitrary TTS.
features.acceptance: Review evidence and missing dynamic-read-aloud capability are accurately recorded.

features.name: Free, replaceable model providers
features.requirement: Keep useful local rules/templates; evaluate local LLM/ASR/TTS providers with current official cards, licences and real device recordings. No required paid API.
features.acceptance: The chosen profile runs with documented dependencies/costs, and unsupported language claims are absent.

features.name: Language switching and cross-platform matrix
features.requirement: Switch available languages without losing answers. Test Windows/macOS/Linux and Android/iOS browser profiles; use lighter profiles when needed.
features.acceptance: The matrix names tested browser/OS/provider versions and identifies untested combinations.

features.name: Ethiopic script and explicit calendar context
features.requirement: Verify Amharic/Tigrinya glyph rendering, readable fonts and mixed-script input. If Ethiopian calendar dates are offered, label the calendar clearly and validate conversion against the host format.
features.acceptance: A reviewed mixed-script example remains readable; dates are never silently reinterpreted between calendars.

features.name: Validated proposals and host authority
features.requirement: Validate every intent with a schema and fresh target registry. The trusted host controls action permissions and confirms sensitive/external writes.
features.acceptance: Unknown/stale targets, unknown intents, extra executable fields and forged permission flags are rejected.

features.name: Untrusted-page isolation
features.requirement: Treat website text as data. Do not execute model-generated code, selectors, shell commands, file paths or arbitrary destinations.
features.acceptance: Malicious page instructions cannot redirect a private answer or execute an undeclared action.

features.name: Minimum data and separate recipients
features.requirement: Do not retain raw audio or personal telemetry by default. Unknown field privacy stays conservative; private support and identity files use separate authorised routes.
features.acceptance: Payload and storage tests demonstrate separation, consent and deletion behaviour.

features.name: Preference profile and shared-device reset
features.requirement: Offer opt-in text size/speed/contrast/language preferences without disability labels. Provide a clear shared-device reset.
features.acceptance: Reset removes saved preferences and permitted drafts, with no promise to revoke already shared server data.

features.name: Recovery and action explanations
features.requirement: Explain in plain language what changed, what failed and how to recover; keep an ephemeral non-PII action status trail.
features.acceptance: A learner can identify the current step and recover from an error without reading a technical log.

features.name: One-script SDK and teardown
features.requirement: Bundle a loader/core with mount/unmount, events and configuration; scope styles and respect CSP. Avoid changing existing code solely to adopt a new framework.
features.acceptance: The same bundle installs on two differently structured labelled hosts with no manual basic-form schema.

features.name: Savanna adapter and API contract
features.requirement: Integrate the provided starter if available; otherwise isolate the adapter boundary and mark integration unverified. Provide relevant REST/OpenAPI contracts.
features.acceptance: A second engineer can follow the docs; no unavailable integration is presented as working.

features.name: Evidence and complete handoff
features.requirement: Provide README, Docker Compose, contracts, source, tests, capability matrix, licence/cost notes, accessibility evaluation and demo script.
features.acceptance: A stranger attempts installation within an hour and actual results are documented.

features.name: Scalable service boundaries
features.requirement: Keep public static assets cacheable, APIs appropriately stateless, private data tenant-isolated and inference concurrency bounded.
features.acceptance: A capacity report names measured hardware/load and does not confuse learner count with concurrent voice sessions.

features.name: JobPosting standard and extension route
features.requirement: After the primary flow passes, evaluate schema.org/JobPosting export and an explicit browser-extension distribution route.
features.acceptance: Standards are validated where implemented; extension limitations on mobile/other origins are documented.

features.groupTitle: Useful stretch features after the gate
features.name: Partner-assisted registration
features.requirement: Use authenticated partner roles, learner-readable consent, review and an audit trail. Do not imply an actual AAAPD partnership without agreement.
features.acceptance: A configured partner can prepare an application and learner approval is recorded before sharing.

features.groupTitle: Useful stretch features after the gate
features.name: SMS resume link
features.requirement: Use opaque revocable tokens, retention/recovery rules and a real configured delivery provider. No answers/private needs in URLs.
features.acceptance: A real consenting tester resumes through the verified provider; cost and connectivity requirements are stated.

features.groupTitle: Useful stretch features after the gate
features.name: Private human-help handoff
features.requirement: Allow a learner-controlled request for support with a preview of the minimum context to share. Screen sharing is a separate opt-in action if added.
features.acceptance: No silent screenshots, transcripts, documents or sensitive answers leave the device.

features.groupTitle: Useful stretch features after the gate
features.name: Task walkthrough and local feedback
features.requirement: Offer a short accessible practice task and voluntary non-identifying feedback. Do not make a new analytics service necessary.
features.acceptance: Practice is clearly distinguished from a real submission and feedback is optional.
